summary.text: Chris New is the Democratic candidate for Iowa House of Representatives District 47 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican Carter Nordman.
A video producer and filmmaker from Dallas Center, New says in a Ballotpedia survey that he is running on public school funding, water quality and government accountability.

paragraphs.text: Chris New graduated from North High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Buena Vista University in 2003, and his listed profession is filmmaker.
In a Ballotpedia survey, New said he began life in eastern Kansas, attended school in Sioux City and has spent more than 20 years as a video producer and small-business owner.
He said he lives in Dallas Center with his wife and three sons.
New defeated Charley Newman in the Democratic primary on June 2, 2026.
In the survey he named pushing back on what he called creeping authoritarianism, accountability for funds used for private education, and water quality among his main messages.
